description: This file defines the ApiAuthorizationSubscriber class which subscribes to kernel controller and exception events to enforce API access control permissions within the OrangeHRM PHP application. It handles permission checks for API controllers and customizes responses for forbidden access.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: This class subscribes to Symfony kernel events to intercept controller actions and exceptions, enforcing API permission policies and handling Forbidden exceptions by customizing the HTTP response.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel events to class methods for subscription, specifically listening to controller and exception events.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks the controller type; retrieves the API class from request attributes; verifies user permissions for the API method; throws ForbiddenException if unauthorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Intercepts ForbiddenException exceptions, crafts a JSON error response, and sets appropriate HTTP status and headers.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Helper to retrieve the controller object from the ControllerEvent.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to permission check method names (canRead, canCreate, canUpdate, canDelete).
